The series has very strong trend and seasonality but unstable ranking; a trimmed mean may robustly reduce influence of outlier models while still using full pool.
Test a weighted combination with softmax_neg_error on the full pool to see if a softmax weighting improves over inverse_error, given the unstable ranking and strong trend/seasonality.
The series shows strong trend/seasonality and unstable rankings; a median pool may be robust to outliers.
Test a weighted combo on a reduced, less correlated pool (pool1) using inverse_error to see if trimming correlated models improves robustness.
The diagnostics suggest a robust combination; try DBA over the full pool to see if iterative refinement improves over weighted w2.
Test a weighted combination on the small, correlated pool1 using softmax_neg_error to see if a probabilistic weighting improves over inverse_error which already underperforms the leader.
The series has a strong trend and seasonality, but ranking is unstable; a robust median over a smaller, more diverse pool (pool1) may reduce variance.
The series shows strong trend/seasonality and unstable ranking; testing a weighted combo on a smaller, more diverse pool (pool3) with inverse_error weights may improve robustness.
The series has strong trend/seasonality and unstable rankings; a robust DBA over a smaller, diverse pool (pool1) may reduce variance and improve performance.
The series shows strong trend and seasonality with unstable rankings; a robust weighted combo over a diverse pool (pool2) could capture complementary strengths.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9877. Series context: trend strength 0.9997 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.185); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.643.
